run_location: prod-box in-container (i-04b155fafcc90042b), user standing campaign approval + explicit deploy authorization this session
what_changed_vs_certified: EXACTLY ONE variable: PR #361 arm-corrected the elicitation decision_point in cli._hillstrom_hypothesis_builder from 'the customer is reading the promotional e-mail in their inbox' (fed to BOTH arms incl. the No-E-Mail control = the confound) to 'the customer is looking at their inbox' (email-free, arm-neutral; the treatment email is carried solely by the already-arm-correct per-arm structural spec). All other config IDENTICAL to the certified run (prereg 59dab05c). This is a single-variable de-confounding re-run.

config.stratifier: by-segment (PR-C persona-aligned: mens_buyer->P02, womens_buyer->P01, high_spender->P03, mid_tier->P04)
config.primary_endpoint: direction_accuracy (sign agreement) — the headline for the de-confound test

prediction_of_record.hypothesis: The certified dir_acc 0.0 (ad-aversion sign inversion) was substantially driven by the decision_point confound: telling the No-E-Mail control it was reading the email inflated control propensity and pushed the treatment-control delta to <=0. With the control de-contaminated, the email's true (positive) effect should surface on at least one arm/segment.
prediction_of_record.directional_prediction: direction_accuracy moves materially OFF 0.0 on at least ONE outcome — most likely VISIT (the more direct 'did the email bring them back' signal) — i.e. the sim now predicts at least some segments where the email RAISES the outcome (positive treatment-control delta), matching the RCT.
prediction_of_record.quantitative_threshold_for_RETRACTION: dir_acc >= 0.5 on >= 1 of {conversion, visit} with a PASSING null-integrity cert (not VOID, n>=8).
honest_failure_modes: (a) Hillstrom's real treatment effect is SMALL and partly sub-deliberative (a marketing nudge) -> a TRUE null can co-exist with the confound removed -> dir_acc may stay at/near 0.0 even with clean control. This is LESS certain to flip than the directional-portfolio's large deliberative effects.
(b) Partial movement (dir_acc rises but < 0.5) -> the confound was contributory but not the whole story; report as partial.

decision_rule.if_dir_acc_off_0_passes_threshold: RETRACT BENCHMARK_REPORT.md §4 banner + §5.1 'intrinsic/model-independent ad-aversion' verdict as a SECOND self-inflicted stimulus-construction false negative (after the directional-portfolio v1). The sim is materially better than the campaign concluded. Note the model-comparison agreement (Groq==Sonnet==0.0) was a shared-harness artifact, not a model-independence property.
decision_rule.if_dir_acc_stays_near_0_both_with_clean_: The intrinsic-limit verdict SURVIVES de-confounding and is STRENGTHENED (it held under a clean stimulus). §4/§5.1 stand; the sub-deliberative-nudge scope boundary is real.
decision_rule.if_cert_voids: report VOID, not trusted; do not draw a conclusion.
